statement: Hands-on operators who never mention AI in their postings are the ones whose postings are mostly scheduling and paperwork; they will need the step (chart note, schedule, form) while saying they need staff.

metrics.name: AI mention share, restaurants & hospitality
metrics.sql: select round(sum(with_need)/sum(asks),3) from demand.need_share where label='AI / LLM / GenAI' and sector='Restaurants & hospitality'

metrics.name: AI mention share, social services
metrics.sql: select round(sum(with_need)/sum(asks),3) from demand.need_share where label='AI / LLM / GenAI' and sector='Social services'

metrics.name: scheduling share, retail
metrics.sql: select round(avg((body ilike '%schedul%')::int),3) from demand.job_sector where sector='Retail'

metrics.name: scheduling share, construction
metrics.sql: select round(avg((body ilike '%schedul%')::int),3) from demand.job_sector where sector='Construction'

metrics.name: paperwork/documentation/charting share, social services
metrics.sql: select round(avg((body ilike '%paperwork%' or body ilike '%documentation%' or body ilike '%charting%')::int),3) from demand.job_sector where sector='Social services'

metrics.name: paperwork/documentation/charting share, healthcare
metrics.sql: select round(avg((body ilike '%paperwork%' or body ilike '%documentation%' or body ilike '%charting%')::int),3) from demand.job_sector where sector='Healthcare'

metrics.name: wont_work claims that proved wrong
metrics.sql: select round(avg((verdict='fear_wrong')::int),3) from cases where claim_type='wont_work'

metrics.name: cases where resisters later became users
metrics.sql: select count(*) from cases where resisters_later_users

next_test: Ship one back-office step (schedule or documentation) to one hands-on sector and measure use, not interest.

statement: Employers in retail and senior care post jobs to buy hours; the need is shift coverage, not more hires.

metrics.name: part-time share, retail
metrics.sql: select round(avg((coalesce(job_type,'') ilike '%parttime%')::int),3) from demand.job_sector where sector='Retail'

metrics.name: part-time share, senior & home care
metrics.sql: select round(avg((coalesce(job_type,'') ilike '%parttime%')::int),3) from demand.job_sector where sector='Senior & home care'

metrics.name: weekends share, retail
metrics.sql: select round(sum(with_need)/sum(asks),3) from demand.need_share where label='Weekends' and sector='Retail'

next_test: Find where the same employer reposts the same part-time role across metros; that is unfilled coverage.

metrics.name: paid training share, automotive
metrics.sql: select round(sum(with_need)/sum(asks),3) from demand.need_share where label='Tuition / training paid' and sector='Automotive'

metrics.name: paid training share, senior & home care
metrics.sql: select round(sum(with_need)/sum(asks),3) from demand.need_share where label='Tuition / training paid' and sector='Senior & home care'

next_test: Pick one licence-bound role (CNA, guard card, CDL) and ship the prep step.

statement: Licence paperwork gates hands-on work and changes by state while the job doesn't; nobody names it as a need.

metrics.name: CDL share, transportation
metrics.sql: select round(sum(with_need)/sum(asks),3) from demand.need_share where label='CDL (any)' and sector='Transportation'

metrics.name: pharmacy licence share, pharma
metrics.sql: select round(sum(with_need)/sum(asks),3) from demand.need_share where label='Pharmacy licence / PTCB' and sector='Pharma & life sciences'

metrics.name: guard card share, government & public safety
metrics.sql: select round(sum(with_need)/sum(asks),3) from demand.need_share where label='Guard card / armed licence' and sector='Government & public safety'

next_test: Map one licence's renewal rules across states from statute; check if a renewal-tracking step is buildable.

statement: The professions loudest against a tool become its heaviest users; bar associations killed free legal advice by radio in 1936 and New York is moving against AI legal aid now.

metrics.name: AI mention share, legal
metrics.sql: select round(sum(with_need)/sum(asks),3) from demand.need_share where label='AI / LLM / GenAI' and sector='Legal'

next_test: Ship to paralegals (the 2:1 majority in legal postings), not attorneys.

statement: Financial warnings, especially from investors, come true; the AI capex arithmetic belongs here. Both true: the spend can crash while the technology stays (bicycle bubble 1897).

metrics.name: financial claims that proved right
metrics.sql: select round(avg((verdict='fear_right')::int),3) from cases where claim_type='financial'

metrics.name: investor warnings that proved right
metrics.sql: select round(avg((verdict='fear_right')::int),3) from cases where warner='investors'

statement: Privacy fears are usually at least partly right: camera glasses, agents with inbox access.

metrics.name: privacy claims right
metrics.sql: select round(avg((verdict='fear_right')::int),3) from cases where claim_type='privacy'

metrics.name: privacy claims mixed
metrics.sql: select round(avg((verdict='mixed')::int),3) from cases where claim_type='privacy'

statement: Job fears are wrong in aggregate and right for named occupations: front desk, data entry and call centers are today's elevator operators. Postings still look healthy, as horse numbers did until about 1915.

metrics.name: jobs claims mixed
metrics.sql: select round(avg((verdict='mixed')::int),3) from cases where claim_type='jobs'

metrics.name: admin & office postings in sample
metrics.sql: select count(*) from demand.job_sector where sector='Admin & office'

statement: Youth and morals fears essentially never come true; don't build a 'protect them from X' business on one.

metrics.name: youth_morals claims right
metrics.sql: select round(avg((verdict='fear_right')::int),3) from cases where claim_type='youth_morals'

metrics.name: youth_morals cases
metrics.sql: select count(*) from cases where claim_type='youth_morals'

statement: Name the objection and who raises it. A user's 'won't work, not for us' is weak; an insider or investor pointing at something specific, mechanical and near-term is strong. Right fears settle fast, wrong ones linger.

metrics.name: median years to verdict, fear_right
metrics.sql: select median(years_to_verdict) from cases where verdict='fear_right'

metrics.name: median years to verdict, fear_wrong
metrics.sql: select median(years_to_verdict) from cases where verdict='fear_wrong'

metrics.name: incumbent-stake fears wrong (does not separate)
metrics.sql: select round(avg((verdict='fear_wrong')::int),3) from cases where incumbent_stake

statement: People don't believe a category until it is their own record, done. Opening on the recipient's own record produced most positive replies on file.

metrics.name: positive replies, their_record opener
metrics.sql: select positive from outreach.reply_rate_by_opener where opener='their_record'

metrics.name: positive replies, all openers
metrics.sql: select sum(positive) from outreach.reply_rate_by_opener

metrics.name: positive replies, pitch opener
metrics.sql: select positive from outreach.reply_rate_by_opener where opener='pitch'
